item.difficulty_reason: After standard simplicial complexes, links and stars, and Stanley local h-polynomial identities, the proof still must derive the rooted forest structure by geometric projection arguments. The tetrahedral classification requires a maximal-depth leaf-star analysis and a terminating corner-cutting enlargement to obtain the conical region needed for induction. These source-local constructions are retained in full and exceed routine qualification exercises.
